facts.fact: Emergence reports that the Council of Ministers of 29 July 2026 approved a draft decree that repeals and replaces the decree of 19 November 2020 governing the Fonds d'accès universel aux services (FAUS), and its headline says the FAUS's resources are centralised in the Treasury; the text says the reform must clarify the fund's integration into the State's budget and accounting framework and gives no replacement terms.

note: Draft decree only; the fund itself is not said to be closed, the 2020 decree is repealed and replaced, and the study file treats this as the repeal; the replacement's terms are not given.
